record.description: Paper I's research name for a boundary-dominant selective-admissibility architecture. Its modeled operators govern how internal states become observable and registered; the essay's universal claims about commercial LLMs remain theoretical unless independently measured.
record.note: The chain usefully separates retrieval, capacity selection, boundary filtering and event admission. Its domains and codomains need declaration. Set inclusion permits equality; strict narrowing at every stage requires a separate argument. The arrows describe a model of selection and cannot identify a provider pipeline from output alone.
